subject: physics
question_text: If P = 2i + 4j + 14k and Q = 4i + 4j + 10k, find the magnitude of P + Q.

verification.note: Sri Chaitanya IPE Junior Fastrack (Rev. May 2024), VERY SHORT ANSWER 5 of Unit 4. The mark split is invented and needs a Telangana IPE teacher; no exam appearance years are printed for Unit 4, so appearances[] stays empty.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Add the vectors
steps.margin_note: Add component by component — i with i, j with j, k with k.
steps.why: Vector addition never mixes directions: each axis adds on its own, which is the whole point of writing vectors in components.

accept: six i plus eight j plus twenty four k

steps.memory_tip: Stack them and add straight down: 2+4, 4+4, 14+10. Nothing crosses between the columns.

steps.label: The magnitude
steps.margin_note: Show the three squares before the root — the working is the mark.
steps.why: The magnitude of any vector in components is the square root of the sum of the squares — Pythagoras in three dimensions.

accept: root six seventy six is twenty six
thirty six plus sixty four plus five seventy six

steps.memory_tip: 36 + 64 + 576 = 676, and √676 = 26. A whole-number root means the addition was right.

insider_note: Two marks, two lines: the sum in components, then the root. Show all three squares — 24² = 576 is where the arithmetic slips.
